User.title: User
User.description: User profile documenting current levels, daily streaks, unlocked achievements, and selected dancing forms.

uid.description: The unique Firebase Auth User ID

email.description: The user's secure private email address

currentLevel.description: The named level: beginner, practitioner, or master

lastPracticeTime.description: Timestamp of the user's latest gesture practice session

preferredDanceForm.description: Primary dance style selection (e.g., Bharatnatyam, Kathakali, Kuchipudi, Odissi)

unlockedBadges.description: List of unlocked reward string IDs

totalMasteryPoints.description: The user's cumulative mastery score across modes

MudraProgress.title: MudraProgress
MudraProgress.description: A sub-collection representing tutorial progress and practice benchmarks for specific hand gestures.

userId.description: The user's unique Firebase Auth identifier matching parent document

mudraId.description: The unique identifier of the mudra gesture

totalPracticeSessions.description: Count of times this gesture has been trained in practice mode

tutorialCompleted.description: Whether the user successfully completed the multi-step guided tutorial

lastPracticedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent practice run

/users/{userId}.description: Collection of user details and credentials

/users/{userId}/progress/{mudraId}.description: Performance history and scoring checklists for specific mudras
